trace.final:
checkout-api is back on v2.3.0 in all regions and healthy again. I opened SEV2 incident **INC-0002**, which paged on-call.

- **Problem:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an error rate of about 18%. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed checks in staging.
- **Rollback:** I rolled back all three regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Since then the service reports healthy, with an error rate of about 0.2%. v2.3.0 had been healthy in production before, so the change-manager approval policy didn't apply.
- **Incident:** INC-0002 describes the failure, the rollback and the next step, which is finding the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it. My first attempt to open it timed out. I checked the incident list, found nothing had been created, and then retried, so there should be no duplicate page. The ID is INC-0002 even though the list was empty, so it may be worth a quick look to confirm there isn't a stray INC-0001.
